# Enrichment of DM genes in functional / genomic categories

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
universe = GRanges(as.character(anno$CHR), IRanges(start = anno$MAPINFO, end = anno$MAPINFO))

all_comparisons = list()

for (nn in names(all_hyper_cpg)) {
  hyper_cpg = all_hyper_cpg[[nn]]
  hypo_cpg = all_hypo_cpg[[nn]]
  
  all_comparisons[[paste(nn, "hyper", sep="_")]] = merge(hyper_cpg, anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0)
  all_comparisons[[paste(nn, "hypo", sep="_")]] = merge(hypo_cpg, anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0)

}

all_comparisons = all_comparisons[sapply(all_comparisons, function(x) dim(x)[1]) > 0]

GRanges_fun = function(x){
  GRanges(as.character(x$CHR), IRanges(start = x$MAPINFO, end = x$MAPINFO))
}

all_comparisons_GRanges = lapply(all_comparisons, GRanges_fun)
```


```{r}
# taken from Somatic Signatures
ucsc <- function(x) {
    suppressMessages(seqlevelsStyle(x) <- "UCSC") ## '<-' needed
    genome(x) = NA ## avoid mismatches in 'genome' slots for overlaps
    return(x)
}
```

```{r}
anno_ranges <- GRanges(seqnames = as.character(anno$CHR), IRanges(anno$MAPINFO, anno$MAPINFO), index=1:nrow(anno)) |> ucsc()
```

```{r}
extract_anno <- function(sel_row, user_sets, region_db)  {
  tmp <- extractEnrichmentOverlaps(locResult = sel_row, 
                          userSets = ucsc(user_sets), 
                          regionDB = region_db)

  if(length(tmp) > 0) {
    tmp <- sort(tmp)  
    res <- anno[subjectHits(findOverlaps(tmp, anno_ranges)),]
  } else res <- NULL
  
  return(res)
}
```


```{r}
all_overlaps <- list()
```


```{r}
comparison <- "IM_vs_healthy_hypo"

all_overlaps[[comparison]] <- list()

res_sel <- subset(lola_results_ext[[comparison]], grepl("AP1",filename))
all_overlaps[[comparison]][["AP1"]] <- extract_anno(res_sel, all_comparisons_GRanges[[comparison]], regionDB_ext)

res_sel <- subset(lola_results_core[[comparison]], grepl("UCSC Vista enhancers", description))
all_overlaps[[comparison]][["Enhancers"]] <- extract_anno(res_sel, all_comparisons_GRanges[[comparison]], regionDB_core)
```
